verdicts.reason: A is the better resize and has a sensible banner split: the copy column sits on the left and the can on the right, with the badge, headline, body and CTA in the right order. Its flaws: the CTA pill is oversized and outweighs the fairly small headline, the logo floats off on its own in the top-right corner away from the copy, and the can is pushed close to the bottom edge. B breaks in several ways: the 'NEW FLAVOR' badge is shrunk to an unreadable size and dropped below the CTA, out of reading order. The headline wraps awkwardly ('Chase the / Light'), the CTA crowds the body copy, and the decorative circles are stretched into ellipses.
